about: BUZZY redesign pitch, IMAGERY lane. Generated mood imagery for the DREAM INVENTORY design (surreal, calm, photoreal). Every image is AI-generated illustrative imagery: never BUZZY's store, staff, customers, products or brands, never a real place. Ids = file names in assets/generated/ (16:9 backdrops and 1:1 tiles as JPEG, 4:5 features generated at 3:4 and cropped to 4:5, cut-outs as transparent PNG via birefnet). 'aspect' = the delivered aspect, 'calmArea' = where type or glass can sit. Order = delivery order.

defaults.style: Photoreal high-end render with the finish of a fine art photograph, surreal yet calm and quiet, soft diffuse morning light, crisp focus, clean modern minimal composition, generous negative space. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no writing, no labels, no logos, no brand marks, no signage anywhere in the image. No people, no faces, no hands, no animals.
